Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines the testing procedures 
P1, to be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.
This document 
out lines how 
to check & schedule service conductivity device 
(18devices) to measure the conductivity in [demy water & feed water &condensate 
water & saturated steam & polisher &cooling water in generator ].
The sample get on a sensor analyzer to measure 
the conductivity value and the device convert it to [4:20mA] or [0:50A] go to a 
recorder
The first draft initiated by & tested by eng. 
Enas Abdel Fattah, reviewed by eng. Ramadan Helmy, revised EDEPC quality control 
eng. Abdel Menem El-Emam, accepted by eng. Ali Abdel-Whab general director, and approved by eng. Mahmod Saker: 
Head Sector of Talkha PP.
This document 
accepted by
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; head sector of planning & financial 
predicting, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control Head 
sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category
A work permit must be 
 issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, safety helmet, 
rubber gloves, ground strap 
...etc.
The unit must be out of services if we work at 
 the device, which measure the conductivity in the cooling water in generator.
For the other samples calibration not require the 
unit be out of services
Turn off the power during cleaning the sensor.

Remove the digital multimeter and screw the
